'''Lyn Me''' was a [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|female]] dancer who performed with the [[Max Rebo Band]] at [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]]'s [[Boba Fett's Palace|Palace]],<ref name="DB Lyn" /> and sang vocals along with [[Greeata Jendowanian]], [[Sy Snootles]] and [[Rystáll Sant]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

Me grew up on the barren [[Ryloth's northern continent|northern continent]] of the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]]. She was saved from [[slavery]] by [[Boba Fett]] and thus hero-worshiped him and fell in love with him as well. She was well-learned in the art of Twi'lek dance.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

==Biography==
[[File:DancingTrio-ROTJ.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lyn Me with fellow dancers Rystáll Sant and Greeata Jendowanian]]
Lyn Me joined the [[Max Rebo Band]] to perform as a singer and dancer. She had a long career that included singing in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Shortly before members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescued]] the captive [[Han Solo]] from Jabba's Palace, Lyn Me and her fellow bandmates performed "[[Jedi Rocks]]" for Jabba's court. Her performance attracted the attention and affection of famed [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]].

Me and her other members of her band were impressed that [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]] killed [[Pateesa|Jabba's rancor]]. She fantasized that he had done it to avenge fellow Twi'lek dancer [[Oola]] for being fed to the beast by Jabba.<ref name="Max Rebo 1">[[Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo 1|''Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo'' 1]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lyn Me was portrayed by [[Dalyn Chew]]. She was added to the extended musical number in the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Old DB">{{DB|character|lynme|Me, Lyn}}</ref>
